name: pylos-mcp
description: Email MCP server for Gmail, Outlook and any IMAP mailbox, hardened against prompt injection
long_description: Search, read and draft your mail while every message reaches the assistant fenced as data, with a Warnings line naming what it hides: hidden text, phrases aimed at an AI, encoded blobs, a Reply-To on another domain, lookalike letters. Moving, sending and deleting stay off until you enable them, and sending only ever reaches the addresses you allow.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: One of outlook, gmail, icloud, yahoo, gmx, fastmail, mailbox.org or posteo. Leave blank for other servers and fill in the IMAP host.

password.title: App password
password.description: An app password for the account. Leave blank for outlook, which signs in through the browser.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Comma-separated tiers beyond reading: drafts, manage, send, delete, sieve-read.

send_allowlist.title: Send allowlist
send_allowlist.description: Who send may address: addresses or *@domain, comma-separated, or * for anyone. Sending stays closed without it.

imap_host.title: IMAP host
imap_host.description: Only for servers without a provider preset.

smtp_host.title: SMTP host
smtp_host.description: Only for servers without a provider preset, and only when send is enabled.

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: Where attachments are saved. Defaults to Downloads.
